props.description: The amount of space between the disclosures.
Whether the disclosure should be displayed with a quiet style.
The contents of the disclosure, consisting of a DisclosureTitle and DisclosurePanel.
Handler that is called when the disclosure's expanded state changes.
Whether the disclosure is expanded by default (uncontrolled).

An id for the disclosure when used within a DisclosureGroup, matching the id used in
`expandedKeys`.

A slot name for the component. Slots allow the component to receive props from a parent
component. An explicit `null` value indicates that the local props completely override all
props received from a parent.
Spectrum-defined styles, returned by the `style()` macro.
